issue.title: test_run_host_registers_for_its_lifetime_and_removes_on_exit crashed its xdist worker under the loaded lane
issue.description:
Found by the sase-1vd land agent while verifying the landing (qa_markdown and docs-only diff on master a29a587104).

In `sase tool run check` 8df1ff7a71078558549a3415646c1d1e, the scoped lane escalated to about 63.8k tests (load1 peak about 119, tree RSS peak 18.5 GiB). pytest-xdist reported `worker 'gw3' crashed while running 'tests/service/test_service_host_registry.py::test_run_host_registers_for_its_lifetime_and_removes_on_exit'`. The node passed in an isolated rerun on the unchanged tree.

A plausible mechanism, not yet confirmed: the test's `_stopper` thread runs `os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGTERM)` in a `finally:` block. If `_wait_for(lambda: bool(_live_service_hosts()), timeout=10)` times out under load, or the signal arrives while `run_host` has no SIGTERM handler installed (before install or after restore), the default SIGTERM disposition kills the xdist worker itself. That matches a "worker crashed" report rather than an assertion failure. Confirm the mechanism before choosing a repair, for example by signalling only after registration was observed and while the host's handler is installed, or by delivering the stop through the host's own shutdown path.

task_type_fields.evidence: 1 loaded-lane failure (xdist worker gw3 crashed, ToolRun 8df1ff7a71078558549a3415646c1d1e, 2026-11-26) and 1 isolated pass on the same tree. Fail rate unknown; not reproduced serially.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (scoped lane escalated to ~63.8k tests under heavy host load); isolated: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/service/test_service_host_registry.py::test_run_host_registers_for_its_lifetime_and_removes_on_exit

issue.creation_reason: A worker crash during the sase-1vd landing check took this node down, and it passes alone. The test SIGTERMs its own process, which can kill the worker under load.
